summary: LubeLogger is a web-based application designed to log and monitor vehicle maintenance records and fuel economy. It provides a centralised interface to record service history, fuel fill-ups, and operational costs for one or more vehicles. This helps vehicle owners maintain a systematic digital logbook of their fleet or personal transport.
goodFor: It is a practical tool for vehicle owners and small fleet operators who want to self-host their maintenance records rather than relying on commercial mobile apps.
watchOut: As a niche utility, it may lack the extensive third-party integrations or automated data imports found in larger commercial fleet management platforms, meaning all entries must be managed manually.
deployNotes: Containerised deployment via Docker or Kubernetes is straightforward, and you will typically need to configure a persistent volume to ensure your maintenance logs and configuration data survive container restarts.
